title: Core Decet #26
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, ten women in a single row.

A photograph of TEN women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 10 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left to right:
[Lebanese Wedding Glam / Heavy Muscle]: Lebanese woman, early 50s, cool and composed, radiant glowing bridal makeup, dramatic long lashes, a soft rose lip, warm fair skin, twin-tail hair, oval nails (glossy). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework (an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera. Shoes: extreme gold extreme platform square-toe heels.

[Jamaican Dancehall Glam / Glamour Hourglass]: Jamaican woman, late 30s, cool and composed, bold bright eyeshadow, a confident energetic expression, deep rich brown skin, low bun hair, stiletto nails (matte). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Spanish Talavera de la Reina ceramic (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre floral medallions), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: caught mid-jump, feet off the ground. Shoes: extreme cobalt platform stiletto slingbacks.

[Nordic valkyrie / Brazilian Booty]: Norwegian woman, mid 40s, cool and composed, fair skin with a light scatter of freckles, strong straight defined dark-blonde brows, warm bronze shadow across the lids, a fine brown liner, long lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, soft contour, a muted red-brown lip, long pale-blonde hair in two thick braids and a braided crown, a fierce, steady, commanding expression, elegant updo hair, square nails (matte). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide. A dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape. A full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Czech Bohemian crystal-engraving motif (a deep black ground with fine engraved silver linework), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip. Shoes: extreme silver extreme platform high heels.

[Carnival Glam / Hourglass SSBBW]: Brazilian woman, late 20s, cheerful, sun-bronzed glowing skin, gold and copper shimmer eyes, a glossy nude-coral lip, wavy hair, stiletto nails (glossy). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic (a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out. Shoes: extreme ochre ballet heels.

[lakorn-drama glam / Curved Bust]: Thai woman, late 30s, demure and soft, flawless pale-golden skin, sharply defined dark brows, a precise black winged liner with a strong flick, warm brown-bronze eyeshadow, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour under the cheekbones, deep red glossy lips with a crisp edge, long glossy black waves, a poised, dramatic expression, elegant updo hair, stiletto nails (holographic). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Korean eunipsa silver inlay (a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward. Shoes: extreme bold silver plain stiletto pumps.

[Spanish Flamenco Glam / USSBBW]: Spanish woman, early 40s, sultry, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, braided hair, square nails (chrome). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic (a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: back fully to camera. Shoes: extreme ochre extreme platform thigh-skimming boots.

[Ao Dai Glam / Hourglass SSBBW]: Vietnamese woman, mid 40s, sultry, soft porcelain skin, delicate rose-pink eyeshadow, glossy soft-coral lips, sleek straight hair, oval nails (glossy). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Norwegian rosemaling folk painting (a deep forest-green ground with bold cream and gold acanthus scrollwork), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back. Shoes: extreme gold platform stiletto cross-strap sandals.

[girl-crush / Super Glamour]: Korean woman, mid 50s, sultry, fair ivory skin, sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, long sleek black hair, a cold, commanding gaze, wavy hair, almond nails (chrome). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Russian Palekh miniature lacquer (a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: leaning one arm on a window frame. Shoes: extreme gold extreme platform wedges.

[hime-gyaru / Legend Bust]: Japanese woman, early 40s, cheerful, fair porcelain skin, soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips, huge voluminous light-brown curls with a big pink satin bow, a sweet princess-like smile, low bun hair, stiletto nails (glittery). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body — the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it. Below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust. The bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Korean eunipsa silver inlay (a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: reclining on her side, propped on one elbow. Shoes: extreme bold silver ballet heels.

[Persian Glam / Muscle Hourglass]: Iranian woman, late 30s, sultry, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, wavy hair, square nails (holographic). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Peruvian Nazca painted pattern (a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: seated across two steps. Shoes: extreme gold platform stiletto knee-high boots.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, every woman an extraordinarily large woman far beyond any real person, generous horizontal spacing so every figure reads clearly and large.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 10, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
